newsitem.title: USA: Mallinckrodt, Molecular say application accepted.
newsitem.headline: Mallinckrodt, Molecular say application accepted.

text.p: A marketing authorization application for an imaging agent called FS069 has been formally accepted as filed by the European Medicines Evaluation Agency, said Mallinckrodt Inc and Molecular Biosystems Inc.
The application was filed under the new centralized application procedures established by the European Union and known as the "fast-track" review process, the companies said.

Under these new procedures, the application will be reviewed by the EMEA. When approved, FS069 may be marketed by Mallinckrodt in all countries of the European Union, including Austria, Germany, the United Kingdom, France, Ireland, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Sweden, Finland, Denmark, Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands and Greece.

The application is for use of FS069 with echocardiography, or ultrasound imaging of the heart, for enhancing images in the assessment of cardiac function. Molecular Biosystems, based in San Diego, developed the agent.
